card.name: Words after "those who" in sayings
card.fires_on: Words in proverb-like or scriptural sayings built on "those who ...", especially "those", "who", and the verb or word that follows. It also appears in quoted religious or moral statements that set up a parallel clause.

modes.label: Those-who sayings
modes.description: The word "those" or "who", or the verb right after, in a saying where one group is contrasted with or matched to another.
modes.example: "There are three types of people in the world: those<< who>> can count, and those who can't

modes.label: Religious promise or maxim
modes.description: A word inside a scriptural or moral statement about what happens to those who act in a certain way.
modes.example: Allah will certainly help those who<< help>> Him – Allah is all-Strong,
